hero.title: Usage and refund policy
hero.copy: This page explains how Builders Fund contributions are handled, how refunds are requested, and how business sponsorships are reviewed before any public visibility.

summary.title: Key points
summary.copy: OpenG7 is an independent project in development. Contributions are not charitable donations and sponsorship visibility is never automatic.

intro.title: How contributions are handled
intro.copy: This policy describes the public operating model of the funding MVP. It is not a substitute for legal, tax, or accounting advice.

nature.title: Nature of contributions
nature.copy: Payments support OpenG7 infrastructure and development.

items.nonCharity: OpenG7 is not presented as a registered charity.
items.noReceipt: No official charitable donation receipt is issued.
items.voluntary: Each payment is voluntary support for the Builders Fund.

payments.title: Stripe payments
payments.copy: Payment starts through Stripe Checkout and is confirmed by webhook when Stripe sends the expected event.

items.stripe: Stripe processes card details and payment confirmations.
items.currency: Public amounts are shown in Canadian dollars when the currency is available.
items.confirmation: Public totals may wait for Stripe synchronization or database confirmation.

refunds.title: Refund requests
refunds.copy: Refunds are reviewed manually to protect the fund, contributors, and accounting records.

items.request: A request must go through support with enough detail to identify the payment.
items.review: OpenG7 may approve, reject, or request more information before processing the request.
items.timing: Timing, fees, and returned funds also depend on Stripe and the financial institution.

disputes.title: Disputes and chargebacks
disputes.copy: Card disputes are handled in Stripe and may affect public states tied to the payment.

items.stripe: A Stripe dispute may create a hold, require evidence, or trigger a temporary debit.
items.visibility: Public visibility tied to the payment may be suspended during review.
items.records: Minimal records are kept for audit, idempotency, and reconciliation.

sponsorship.title: Business sponsorships
sponsorship.copy: A paid sponsorship is not published automatically. It goes through a follow-up form and admin review.

items.review: The administrator approves, rejects, or returns the sponsorship to review.
items.followup: The follow-up link can reopen the form and show status while the token is valid.
items.noAutomaticPublication: Logo, message, website, and feed placement remain private until approval.

visibility.title: Public visibility and feeds
visibility.copy: OpenG7 keeps editorial control over sponsorships that appear publicly.

items.approval: An approved sponsorship may appear on the public sponsors page.
items.removal: OpenG7 may reject, remove, or edit visibility that is incompatible, misleading, or risky.
items.feed: Facebook and LinkedIn placements indicate prepared or tracked publication, not an automatic guarantee.

privacy.title: Privacy and public data
privacy.copy: The platform favors aggregated transparency and limits published personal data.

items.publicData: Public names, amounts, and sponsorships are displayed only under applicable consent and review rules.
items.privateData: Emails, Stripe identifiers, and payment details are not shown publicly.
items.aggregate: Totals, fees, and estimates may remain public in aggregate form.

contact.title: Need help with a contribution?
contact.copy: Use the support page for a refund request, a sponsorship question, or a payment issue.
